designOrigin: Independently frozen before any Trial 32 economic output was observed. A source-only probe, which calculated no prices, funding values, signal, P&L, return, or ranking statistic, established complete 2024-2025 cross-venue coverage for XRP, ADA, BNB, and LTC. Trial 33 is a precommitted replication basket using those four source-qualified liquid assets with the same 90%-notional proactive stress-buffer architecture as Trial 32. No Trial 32 result informed asset selection or parameters.
hypothesis: If the cross-venue funding dislocation is a broad venue effect rather than a BTC/ETH-specific episode, an independently frozen second basket of source-qualified liquid assets should also clear the 7% annualized development floor and retain positive, robust carry in the 2026 holdout.

finalHoldout.accessRule: Final market rows and economics may be observed only after every frozen development gate passes.

strategy.direction: always long Binance perpetual and short equal-coin Hyperliquid perpetual
strategy.proactiveCollateralTriggerRule: After realized price/funding PnL at each 8h boundary, fail actual 5% maintenance first. If either venue lacks a 10%-of-notional reserve above a 20% adverse unilateral gap plus 5% maintenance, equalize sleeve capital to 45% Binance / 45% Hyperliquid / 10% cash at the frozen transfer cost before applying hypothetical stress.

fundingClock.hyperliquid: Use raw Hyperliquid fundingHistory settlement/publication event time; sum records in (previous 8h boundary,current boundary], do not backdate or interpolate.
fundingClock.causality: Only actually settled funding cash is booked.

antiRescueRule: After the first Trial 33 development economic output, no scientific parameter, asset, notional, stress buffer, collateral target, transfer cost, clock rule, or gate may change under Trial 33.
